anchors.description: Width across the bed head, measured between the centers of the two turned wooden headboard posts (mattress head width).
anchors.visible_evidence: Both wooden headboard posts are fully visible at the same height against the wall; the straight line between their front faces runs horizontally across the head of the bed.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Mattress size is not directly readable; US full/double (~1.37 m) vs queen (~1.52 m) assumed, and post centers may lie slightly outside the mattress edges.

anchors.description: Width of the closed white horizontal-slat window blind above the headboard, measured from its left edge to its right edge at one slat level.
anchors.visible_evidence: The white slat blind fills the window opening above the bed; both of its vertical edges are visible and both endpoints lie on the slat surface.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Blind width matches the window rough opening; standard US double-hung window widths 0.61-0.91 m assumed, and the blind plane sits a few cm inside the frame.

anchors.description: Across the top edge of the plaid bed pillow propped against the headboard, between its two upper corners (pillow width).
anchors.visible_evidence: The plaid pillow leans against the headboard; both endpoints are on the pillow's plaid fabric along its top edge.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard (20x26 in) vs queen (20x30 in) pillow is unknown, and the backward lean foreshortens the visible edge, so the chord can be shorter than the nominal pillow width.
